milestones.title: Edges refuse credentials whose status list is older than the level allows

remediation: An edge that cannot reach HQ uses the last status list it received. A revoked credential stays trusted there until that list passes the longest offline time allowed for the level, which your organization's security officer sets in the signed policy. The defaults are 7 days for Protected A, 72 hours for Protected B and 24 hours for any classified level. Your organization's authorizing official accepts the lag for each level.
title: A revoked credential stays trusted at an offline edge until its list is too old
